purpose: Explicit context envelope for Check Data Segment artifacts.

entryMethod.note: Machine-testable trigger for MANUALLY_ENTERED is REVIEW_REQUIRED: SEG110-SME-003

micrFormat.note: Selector is element 239 field 12, whose identity conflicts with the Chapter 13 Enhanced Fleet Data definition: SEG110-SME-005

conditionalContext.driversLicenseBundle: Driver's License, State Code, and Check Number applicability depend on the unresolved manually-entered trigger (SEG110-SME-003).
conditionalContext.dateOfBirth: Trigger separate from or bundled with the identification fields is REVIEW_REQUIRED (SEG110-SME-004).
conditionalContext.micrOverflow: Hosting segment for Extended MICR Data (Element 137) when MICR Data exceeds 50 bytes is REVIEW_REQUIRED (SEG110-SME-002).
conditionalContext.segment100CrossReference: Byte-identity requirement between MICR Data (110) and Account Number (100) is REVIEW_REQUIRED (SEG110-SME-007).

validationRules: Do not use a generic Financial Transaction Request fixture as proof that Segment 110 may appear outside the ECA/TeleCheck envelope.
State Code must agree with the Appendix D catalog when Driver's License is present.
Check Type must be P or C; no other value is documented.
Missing required context is REVIEW_REQUIRED unless source proves it unnecessary.
AI fixtures are not independent source evidence.
